title: Implement DID-signed payload passthrough
description:
If the incoming article contains an X-Usenet-IPFS-DID-Sig: header, pass it through unchanged into the stored article. Do not validate the DID signature (v1 does not implement DID resolution). Expose the header to readers via ARTICLE/HEAD responses. Document the passthrough behavior. Artifact: reader/src/post/did_passthrough.rs and docs/did_passthrough.md.

Acceptance:
- Article with X-Usenet-IPFS-DID-Sig: stores and retrieves the header unchanged
- Article without the header stores and retrieves without adding any DID header
- No DID resolution or validation attempted
- docs/did_passthrough.md explains what the header means and that v1 does not validate it
